meta.title: A withdrawn event cannot be re-activated

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_withdraw_…”, with the status set to “withdrawn”.
The buyer publishes the event with 1 draft trade request uuids.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals withdrawn.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals withdrawn.
